The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten message by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F. M. Cap.
(WRITTEN ON THE FLYLEAF OF VOLUME FOUR, THE CORONATION VOLUME, OF THE"MYSTICAL CITY OF GOD" BOOKS)
Dear Reader: --
TO KNOW IS TO APPRECIATE.
The following pages with the books that preceed this, would seem to offer an example of supreme asceticism .
As iron in fire is imbued with the nature of the fire, so in a maner is Mary the Virgin Mother of God impued, en- livened, with the divine nature
To know her too means to appreciate and to love -- both her and her Divine Son.
Praised forever be God in His Works! -- and in His Master- piece of all masterpieces. His own Immaculate Mother Mary and Virgin!
Original in possession of:
Mrs. Arthur (Georgia) Gietzen Fr. Solanus, O. M. Cap. 22237 Virginia St. E. Detroit, Mich. 48021
